query:
-- Physics questions misclassified as Small Parts
UPDATE quickfireQuestions 
SET category = 'Physics'
WHERE id IN (582, 583, 584, 585);

-- MSK anisotropy artifact question misclassified as Small Parts
UPDATE quickfireQuestions 
SET category = 'MSK'
WHERE id = 586;

-- Verify final counts
SELECT category, COUNT(*) as count 
FROM quickfireQuestions 
WHERE category IN ('Small Parts','Physics','MSK','POCUS')
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category;
